newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen condemns intervention in Sudan affairs.
newsitem.headline: Yemen condemns intervention in Sudan affairs.

text.p: Yemen said on Sunday it was saddened by the military conflict in Sudan and condemned foreign intervention in the Arab state's internal affairs.

"We are saddened by what is taking place in Sudan, we condemn any intervention in the internal affairs of Sudan and we are with the unity of brotherly Sudan," Prime Minister Abdul-Aziz Abdul-Ghani told a news conference.

Sudan's Islamist government has called for mobilisation against what it says are Ethiopian and rebel assaults on eastern Sudan. It has also accused Eritrea of taking part in the fighting, which Eritrea denied.
Yemen and Eritrea are engulfed in a dispute over Red Sea islands lying on busy oil tanker routes.
